hero.title: Coming back is the hard part
hero.lede: You know how to build the thing. What you lose is the thread: what you decided, what you were waiting on, and why you dropped the approach that looked right in month two.
hero.caption: Fig. 00. A project, as it looks after three weeks away.

return.title: The screen that answers where you were
return.lede: Open a project after a month away. Before you navigate anywhere, it tells you what is open, what you last did, and what you already decided.
return.caption: Fig. 01. The resume view, annotated.

accrual.title: The record writes itself
accrual.lede: Nobody keeps a project journal for two years. So the log is not a second job: closing a piece of work asks what closed it, and that answer is the record.

steps.two: Say what finished it, in one line.
steps.three: That line is attached to the work permanently, and it is what you read when you come back.

accrual.closing: Two years of this is a document nobody sat down to write.
accrual.caption: Fig. 02. Closing a work item captures the entry that closed it.

items.tasks: Not a task manager. Open items matter, but a list of them is not a record.
items.wiki: Not a wiki. Documents live here, but the log is what you actually come back for.
items.streaks: No streaks, no badges, no celebration of starting. Nothing here rewards you for showing up.
items.reminders: No reminders. It waits. When you come back, it tells you what changed while you were gone.
items.habits: Not for habits or fitness. Those want adherence tracking, which is a different product.

agent.title: The part that reads it back to you
agent.now: Projects, the log, nested work items with real states including blocked and a wake date, documents, and the resume view. Private to you.
agent.next: An agent grounded in your own repository: recall and synthesis over your decisions and dead ends, not generic advice. It is not built yet.
agent.why: Which is the reason to start now. The agent is only worth having if there is a record for it to read, and that record takes months to accumulate. Starting today is what makes it useful later.

start.title: Start the record
start.lede: One project, private, free while it is early. If you are in the middle of something long, the useful moment to begin was a year ago. Second best is today.
start.honesty: Early access. What exists today is described in plate 04, exactly.
